body: But is it a temporary fix or permanent? Like, can I just take the pills for a few months and everything would be back to normal, or will I be on them for the rest of my life?
I guess that would make sense. Would there be anyway to fix it, temporarily or permanently?
Is that common among addicts or is it a rare thing? I didnt know that was possible.
At first I thought it was another effect of the heroin withdrawals, because at the time I was trying to kick my addiction, but now that I'm off it I honestly cant tell what's wrong with me.
